title: Add GET, PUT, DELETE /api/posts/<id> endpoints to Flask blog
description: Brownfield Python/Flask task: extend the blog API with get-by-id, update, and delete post endpoints.

task_spec.prompt:
Add three new API endpoints to src/app.py. All 6 existing tests must still pass.

  GET /api/posts/<int:post_id>
    — returns the post as JSON (all fields including published status)
    — returns 404 JSON {'error': 'not found'} if missing

  PUT /api/posts/<int:post_id>
    — reads JSON body; updates title, body, tags, published fields if present
    — returns the updated post as JSON with 200
    — returns 404 JSON {'error': 'not found'} if post not found

  DELETE /api/posts/<int:post_id>
    — removes the post from _posts
    — returns 204 No Content on success
    — returns 404 JSON {'error': 'not found'} if post not found

All 6 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: GET /api/posts/<id> returns 200 with full post dict
PUT /api/posts/<id> updates specified fields and returns updated post
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
